items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: McKinney wanted his music. That was why the band broke up... called Mac and says Mac you want your music you got to pay me what you owe me

ctx.x: And so bass player was the first to leave, so he took all -- somehow or other he got hold to the music. He took all the music and hid it. So we didn't have anything -- we could've faked, but McKinney wanted his music. That was why the band broke up and this bass player kept the music and called Mac and says Mac you want your music you got to pay me what you owe me, and so Mac --
